title: Orrery scene (orr.scene/1)
description: Strict YAML scene file. No anchors, aliases or tags. Types come from this schema, not from the YAML text.

singletons.description: One value per singleton type of the frame.

entities.description: Entities by stable GUID. Keys are sorted on save.

orr.Fixed.description: Fixed-point number, Q48.16 (1/65536 steps). Write a plain decimal such as 12, -0.5 or 3.25: no exponent, no '+', no quotes. The loader reads it with integer arithmetic (never as a float) and rounds to the nearest 1/65536, so 0.1 is stored as 0.1000061. Files are written with the shortest decimal that reads back to exactly the same value.

orr.Fixed32.description: Fixed-point number, Q16.16 (1/65536 steps, range -32768 to 32767.99998). Same text rules as the 64-bit fixed-point number: a plain decimal, rounded to the nearest 1/65536.

orr.EntityRef.description: GUID of another entity of the scene (e_ and 8 to 32 lowercase hex digits), or null for no entity.
